profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Waymo (formerly the Google Self-Driving Car Project)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on Google's core search serving system. Specialized in the parts responsible for low-latency updates to the search index.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Early-stage employee, second hire after founders. We built a cluster-scale analytic database. Company acquired in April 2011 by Teradata for over $300M.

Some highlights:
• Led architecture, design, and implementation on what became a flagship feature of the product (SQL-MapReduce).
• Co-authored paper on SQL-MR published in VLDB 2009. Gave conference talk/Q&A session.
• Led design and implementation of two joint development projects with a major partner.
• Designed and implemented initial versions of the service coordinating replication, fail-over, and scale-out of data stored in the cluster.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Improved a distributed, horizontally-partitioned look-aside cache for customer data. Implemented varying caching methods, basic redundancy, and reduced configuration.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Summer internship with Professor David Cheriton. Designed and implemented a system to auto-generate a command line interface supporting nested object queries for .NET programs.

positions.title: Contributor
positions.description: Co-authored, documented, and maintain Boost Variant discriminated union library. Applied sophisticated C++ template metaprogramming for type-safety, run-time efficiency. See <http://www.boost.org/libs/variant> for more information.

publications.title: SQL/MapReduce: A practical approach to self-describing, polymorphic, and parallelizable user-defined functions

patents.title: Method and system for analyzing ordered data using pattern matching in a relational database
System and method of massively parallel data processing
